capabilities: Publish a note to Cnblogs via right-click command
Update an already-published post on re-upload
Rename the published post when the local note is renamed
Handle local images in published notes
Verify connection with a test button in settings
disambiguation: Not cross-device vault syncing; it publishes notes to a Cnblogs blog.
extras: README is written in Chinese. Users must enable the MetaWeblog blog client API on their Cnblogs account before configuring the plugin.
motivation: The author notes that Markdown frees writers from layout work and wanted to sync md notes to Cnblogs easily without affecting local files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a Cnblogs blog, including uploading notes that reference local images.

relations.evidence: 社区插件市场内搜索 Custom Attachment Location

requires.name: Cnblogs blog with MetaWeblog access enabled

summary: Publishes Markdown notes to the Cnblogs blogging platform, updating or renaming posts and handling local images.
